description: Stamp content with a permanent provenance record. Pass the sha256 hash of the content (hash it locally; the content itself is never uploaded). Returns an instant signed receipt: attach its verifyUrl, byline, badgeEmbed, and qrUrl to the published artifact. The receipt's `publisher` field carries the account's verified identity (domain/handle) or null. If you have no key, call create_account, store its one-time secret, and retry this same call with `Authorization: Bearer <secret>` (its `freeStamp` says whether a free stamp comes with it). If the response is `payment_required` or `quota_exhausted`, call buy_stamps and give a person the returned checkout link (prepaid packs never expire: 5 for $1.00, 10 for $1.50, 50 for $5.00, 100 for $8.00, 500 for $35.00, 1,000 for $65.00, 2,000 for $120.00 (USD, plus any sales tax, VAT or GST added at checkout)), poll get_balance until the stamps arrive, then retry. To pay per stamp instead, sign one advertised x402 requirement and send it as a `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` HTTP header: tool arguments can't carry it, so either configure your MCP client to send that header or POST the same JSON to https://makemark.io/proof directly. An `invalid_api_key` error means the key is mistyped or revoked: create a new one. Optional `madeBy` and `aiDisclosure` become a creator statement: signed by Mark as its own record beside the receipt and anchored with it; the receipt returns it with `statementBound: true`. It is the marker's own statement, shown as such and never verified. Its text shows only on `visibility: public` records; the owner can correct it later with correct_statement. usageNote and location are unsigned notes, shown only on public records. The stamp asserts provenance from a signer at a time, not authorship truth.

aiDisclosure.description: Optional, honest statement of AI involvement. Signed with madeBy as the creator statement.

canonicalSlug.description: Optional stable slug for a canonical latest-version pointer

contentHash.description: sha256 hex of the exact content bytes (64 chars)

location.description: Optional, creator-opt-in only: where this was made

madeBy.description: Optional: who made the work, as the person marking it states it. byMarker true means "I made this". Ask the person; never guess a name.

byMarker.description: The person marking the file made it

previousProofId.description: For a new version of already-stamped content: the prior proof id

usageNote.description: Optional usage/license line, e.g. "Free to share, with credit"

name: create_proof
